name: Travel
q: Ask even when you know the way
The world is a book; travelers read more pages
Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry
You must get lost to truly find the way
Ten thousand miles teach more than books
While parents live, do not travel far
Every day a journey, the road my home
The real voyage is having new eyes
To travel hopefully is a better thing than to arrive
They change the sky, not the soul
Many cities of men he saw, and learned their minds
The world is an inn; time, a traveler
Traveling — it leaves you speechless, then turns you into a storyteller
A good traveler leaves no tracks
